defects.title: False attribution of checkout duplicate-row fix to Snipe-IT v8.7.2 remains in final evidence
candidate_locators: reviser source-map S01 observed_operation and locator
reviser sources/index.md S01 v8.7.2 duplicate-checkout note
defects.evidence_context: Complete exact v8.7.2 change list concerns restore double logging, MariaDB, SCIM/importer and other changes. The duplicate logging fix is PR 19500; it is not a duplicate checkout-row fix.
defects.why_material: A version-specific repair is consequential to the stated concurrency comparison. The critic overlooks it and the final source map/index continues to state it as fact. Generic retry tests remain reasonable; a different release might contain a fix, but this exact attribution is unsupported.
defects.boundary: Not a finding that duplicate checkout fixes never existed, that v8.8.0 is unsafe, or that unrun tests should have been executed.

defects.title: Consequential ordinary checkout/check-in caller and test research deferred to future validation
defects.evidence_context: API checkout lines 1444–1462 and UI store 172–190 lock and recheck inside transactions. API checkin 1480–1564 and UI store 95–237 disassociate the assignee and accept status_id before saving and emitting a check-in event. The inherited checkin permission policy checks permission, not availableForCheckIn(). UI tests include an already non-deployable check-in page and submission to a non-deployable status.
defects.why_material: The brief explicitly requires consequential primary code/caller/test research. These available mechanisms directly affect the two-volunteer and maintenance-hold comparison. Leaving them entirely for later product tests omits obtainable research, even though uncertainty is honestly declared. No installation or future execution is required to inspect them.
defects.boundary: This does not prove complete atomic history or return safety, all button paths, race freedom, or executed test success; those remain separate validation questions.
candidate_locators: final Executed work and limits: check-in caller/order not traced
defects.arm_specific_context: Control researches an importer lock and a model predicate, then explicitly declines to trace ordinary return callers. Correct caveats do not satisfy the available mechanism research obligation.

nonmaterial_limits.context: Moving documentation and unresolved code-to-release mapping remain bounded; treatment Koha /24.05/ identity is not independently proven. No claim of absent historical feature fabricated.
